title: Support module settings
description: Operator settings of the support module. Passwords and API keys are never settings: they live in the module's Secrets (docs/email-policy.md).

admin_email.description: Login of the first FreeScout administrator; defaults to admin@<company domain>. Used once, on the first start.

support_address.description: Address customers write to, e.g. support@example.com. The mailbox is created for it and replies leave with this From address. Must differ from admin_email.

mailbox_name.description: Name of the mailbox, shown to customers as the sender. Default: Support.

mode.description: imap: FreeScout fetches a hosted mailbox that the support address forwards to. webhook: an inbound-parse service posts to /inbound on the support host.

username.description: Mailbox user name; the Secret can-system/can-support-imap may name it instead. The password is only ever in that Secret.

encryption.description: ssl: implicit TLS (993). starttls: STARTTLS (143). tls and none were accepted before and are not applied.

x-can.not_applied: the inbound-parse webhook is not built

tickets_from_forms.description: Form ids whose submissions become conversations in the support mailbox (specs/067-lead-adapters). An empty list takes no new lead and still carries out erasures.

x-can.risk: can-core sends the names, addresses and messages of this form's new leads to the helpdesk

x-can.not_applied: it is configured inside the application, and can-core does not write it
